sentences.text: Hmph. Luna, the data shows no spectral activity, only measurable environmental shifts in the living room.
Between 03:00 and 06:00, the humidity rose to 41.2 %, exceeding the expected range of 36.2 % to 38.3 %.
Concurrently, the temperature dropped to 16.6 °C starting at 04:20, which is lower than the expected 18.0 °C.
Since these changes occurred together, I probably suggest that an open window or a sudden draft caused the humidity and temperature to shift simultaneously.
